'''Unko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Unko attempted to find a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to transport a cargo of illicit contraband from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. He initially offered the job to the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Dwanar Gher]] and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] associate [[Nanika Senoj]], but the pair declined. Unko subsequently hired Gher to assist him with finding someone who was willing to accept the assignment and while drinking in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the pair offered the job to the smuggler [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]. However, Rendar turned them down because [[Outrider/Legends|his starship]] was non-functional and required repairs.
